content.text:
All three tests now pass. Two bugs in `textstats/core.py` caused the failures:

- **`tokenize`:** The regex `[a-z]+` split words at apostrophes, so "don't" became two tokens. It is now `[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)*`, which keeps apostrophes inside words.
- **`top_words`:** The sort used only `-count`, so tied words stayed in insertion order. The key is now `(-count, word)`, which breaks ties alphabetically.

I didn't edit the tests.
